questions.question: Why was Miyo incarnated on the night of October 31, 2018?
questions.subject: Rokujushi Miyo/Synopsis

answer.item: Rokujushi Miyo was a sumo enthusiast who is incarnated on the night of October 31, 2018 by Kenjaku to participate in the Culling Game.

questions.question: Why did time pass faster inside Miyo's simple domain?
questions.subject: Rokujushi Miyo/Synopsis

answer.item: As it turns out, due to Miyo's barrier removing any binding vow, time flows faster within the domain, allowing the two to engage in so many sumo bouts when less than one minute's worth of time has passed outside of it.

questions.question: How did Maki exorcise Naoya while he was in his own domain?
questions.subject: Rokujushi Miyo/Synopsis

answer.item: he was throwing the Split Soul Katana to Maki, who was behind Naoya and is unaffected by the domain's effects due to her Heavenly Restriction. Maki then singlehandedly exorcises Naoya, freeing the three from the domain, albeit leaving Miyo and Daido severely wounded.

questions.question: Where did Maki suggest Daido and Miyo hide?
questions.subject: Rokujushi Miyo/Synopsis

answer.item: Maki subtly told the two that Tokyo was the safest location to hide in since it was filled with cursed spirits and declared off-limits by the government, suggesting that they hide there.
